abilities.label: SPELL

dependencies.detail: Need per-instance damage state and conditional return of the spell itself, not a fresh fixed card.

decisions.question: What does excess carry?
alternatives: Remaining instance damage 8 -> 5 -> 3; positive excess only
decisions.chosen: Remaining instance damage 8 -> 5 -> 3; positive excess only
decisions.discriminating_case: 8 damage against 3 HP returns 5; next 5 against 2 HP returns 3; zero excess and Divine Shield return nothing.

decisions.question: Does Spell Damage affect Torch?
decisions.discriminating_case: Cast with +1 Spell Damage and inspect damage and returned parameter.

unexpressed.span: Return this to hand with any excess damage.
unexpressed.why: IR has no persistent per-card damage parameter or spell-return contract; local variables cannot preserve 8 -> 5 -> 3 over repeated plays, and return requires positive actual excess with no return through Divine Shield.
